pages.restoration-must-reach-the-consequ.text: Restoration Must Reach the Consequences — Vextreme
Truthful witness, accountable power, and justice beyond formal closure

A conversation that begins by distinguishing punishment avoidance from understanding and develops into a larger restorative question: when suppression, concealment, delay, delegated authority, false accusation, or institutional action has already changed what follows, justice cannot be measured only by whether a case was closed. The record follows responsibility through witness, attention, consent, claims, networks, courts, intermediaries, correction, and the consequences inherited afterward.
